To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

1. we introduce efficient training algorithms for linear survival support vector machine models and 3 kinds of non linear models, 2. the proposed training algorithms outperform existing ones, 3. we validate the models on 6 medical datasets, 4. the proposed ranking based models outperform regression and combined ranking and regression models, and 5. our proposed models are competitive to existing survival analysis techniques.

1) we propose efficient training algorithms to train linear survival support vector machine models, 2) we extend our training algorithms to non linear models too, 3) our algorithms outperform the current state of the art in terms of computational time and memory requirements, and 4) we validate our models on real world datasets.
